components.summary: Dispatches current-tree commands and reports progress toward one target.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch to map, proof and template commands; keep scan project ignores untouched and print one empty-model release summary; contract template setup names COMPONENTS and PARENT; export read --mermaid, optionally focused by component; release rejects uncovered contract invariants while map models only warns; show each scoped cycle or layer violation once as an ARCH line in change; include the built-in system root in release declared/executed counts; models --tests runs bound tests and release always checks their individual implementation reach; non-strict check and change annotate only planned breakage, report static target work without running target models, and release warns about a target while checking only the strict current tree

show the existing owner of a behavior and the component that defines an exact symbol, with files, state and side effects (read --find) and owning model ids; read --target shows static node changes and supports component details or Mermaid, while --find remains a separate mode

components.summary: Owns map schema, model bindings and component fingerprints.
responsibilities: validate, load and save the map, writing depends_on sorted and deduplicated; read, validate and merge the one target map as a pure overlay without changing the current tree; resolve one complete optional model view with canonical paths and explicit missing mappings, retaining ordinary registry behavior by default; validate explicit entrypoint, state and side-effect removal intents against the current map without deleting extra content
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions
read model literals (MODEL_ID, PARENT, COMPONENTS, IMPLEMENTED_BY, TESTED_BY, NOT_MODELED, DESIGN_ONLY) without importing the model; recognize the optional project_parent_state hook
count strings as dependency evidence only in import-like contexts

build the model tree: PARENT, default parents and model imports; nesting mistakes are errors; derive each model's components from COMPONENTS, anchor owners and home (runners also use listings); distinguish root home from a component named system; warn when a model's bound test file is outside every component's test patterns; a child import of its explicit model parent does not invert the tree, while impact keeps the real import edge
treat an unknown PARENT, a PARENT loop, parent_import_mismatch, child_outside_parent and duplicate_child_owner as errors; keep test_not_nested and child_start_gap as warnings
resolve imports through removed model paths supplied by impact without registering historical models as executable nodes

components.summary: Discovers entrypoints, effects and reachable calls.
responsibilities: discover entrypoints, side effects and state writers; propagate an explicit no-cache-write mode without creating cache directories
del statements count as state writes; expose exact anchor state writes for model checks

components.summary: Checks ownership, reviews architecture and selects checks.
responsibilities: verify the map against code; name the owners next to an unmapped file; every model and runner declares IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors that resolve (contract models also conformance()) unless marked DESIGN_ONLY; report model-tree nesting warnings; every model's components come from COMPONENTS, anchors and PARENT, with unrelated map listings warned and ignored for selection; check and lint share one structural rule set (cycles, layer violations) and show the shortest import path; share type-separated responsibility, state and side-effect duplicate-owner rules with the root model; warn when unanchored code writes state that a model covers, honoring global anchors and explicit negative scope; accept an explicit merged model view without changing checks on the ordinary current tree

impact selection (depends_on order is irrelevant): retain surviving current and historical tests/models; select models and runners by their anchored files and TESTED_BY tests; block missing or ambiguous test commands; select no checks for comment-only edits after normalizing physical newlines; retain the full closure for unchanged and newline-only requests; a changed existing model or model helper also selects every importing model and every ancestor model, without adding their tests; name owning models in REVIEW and impact JSON; expand explicit importing review children of selected model parents to a fixed point; ignore target draft paths before impact analysis, and filter replaced model suggestions without dropping selected tests

recognize real Git-removed contracts through the canonical static registry; omit missing retired paths only when current references are gone, preserve surviving parents, importers and their tests, and select same-id replacement paths
review architecture; a cycle debt covers its member set, and a grown cycle stays an error; group more than three unlisted entrypoints per owner and strength without changing severity

rank behavior owners, prioritizing exact symbol definitions; show one system/component/model tree and its Mermaid equivalent; derive purpose, rules, known-bad, code and test facets from static source and map facts without importing user models; count real test functions and subtree bindings, marking nonnested and untested bindings; own the shared structural rules and source-filtered known-bad generator; name an existing target or its invalid-map warning in the current tree header without running checks; compare current and merged target facets from their selected physical model source, show additions, changes and removed-node tombstones with stable identities, and share the same text budget and five-facet details
compare current owner promises with merged target owners and explicit removal intent when checking a target
one owner per entrypoint; external promises are modeled or explained; warn about the retired behavior ledger without reading it
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache

components.summary: Keeps one target and checks its merged tree against actual code and tests.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target without executing models or code checks

check the current tree with the target applied using native static checks and fresh model proofs with bound tests; separate design errors from code and test work; write no project files or caches; keep entrypoint_owner findings as design errors
identify exact current component, model and flow findings covered by the target; preserve unplanned failures and expose the same static target checks without model execution

promote a target after one complete check and unchanged checked inputs, writing its prepared map and model bytes, leaving changed components draft, and reporting partial I/O failures without automatic recovery
stop a target that silently drops an entrypoint, state or side effect
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Runs model proofs, precise placeholder failures, individual bound-test reach and native architecture rules with ordinary result messages.
responsibilities: run models and their known-bad and conformance checks; warn about every invariant that no known-bad variant violates; load sibling model imports from the model directory; derive component model hints and runner scope from the tree; release fails on them; check a child's start states only when it declares project_parent_state, without lending parent-check calls to child anchors; report the actual design invariant and known-bad variant names without rerunning proof hooks, abbreviating only their text display; run models on the current tree with the target applied in one temporary model namespace with canonical filenames, selected sibling sources and finally restoration; keep default proof judgments and tag actual code gaps for target classification

fail a model or runner whose IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors are missing, unresolved or never consulted (called or read); give conformance a static code-facts reader (anchors, words, imports of or references to a symbol outside its own file) and load the code an anchor names
own bounded subprocess cleanup shared by models and pytest shards; nested POSIX helpers share one session

run the built-in root model 'system' using the shared static architecture rules and known-bad generator from map analysis, with map check as conformance; reject shared state or side-effect ownership through that same architecture rule owner
run each model's TESTED_BY tests under the anchor watch; each bound test and parameter case must pass and call or explicitly read at least one implementation anchor in its own call window
preserve real anchors and expose planned Fact reports with a DESIGN_ONLY conformance gate
return optional per-test statuses from the existing bound-test execution and report exact placeholder anchor failures without a traceback
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested
